description: This Dart source file provides mock implementations for fetching books and placing orders in a book browsing and ordering app. It contains functions for retrieving a list of Book objects based on a search query and simulating order placement, along with a predefined list of mock books.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: A data model representing a book, with properties like id, title, author, description, price, imageUrl, rating, ratingCount, and tags.

methods.name: fetchBooks
methods.description: Fetches a list of Book objects, optionally filtered by a search query (title, author, or tags). It simulates network latency.

methods.name: placeOrderMock
methods.description: Simulates placing an order with specified items and total price, returning a mock order ID after a delay.
